item.description:
What's new in Sonault 1.7.0

  • Big libraries are dramatically faster. Playing or favouriting a sound used to make Sonault re-read your entire library first — with thousands of sounds that was a visible stall on every click. It no longer happens.
  • Opening your library is several times quicker, and search and ⌘K now keep up as you type instead of lagging a keystroke behind.
  • Scrolling the list view stays smooth no matter how many sounds you have: rows are now built as they come into view, the way the grid already worked.
  • Waveforms are loaded only for the sounds actually on screen, so a large library no longer spends time and memory on shapes you can't see.
  • Fixed a rare case where renaming a sound could quietly undo a favourite, or lose the fact that you had just played it.
